# E0603: dependency named unlike its package

A dependency's entry has its package's own name, so that its modules have one name everywhere. Rename the entry.

- Rule: [`packages.dependency-names`](../../reference/04-programs.md#packages.dependency-names)
- Reported at: the entry's key.
- Tier: `core`, checked in the `items` phase

## What the compiler prints

The program [`E0603_named_unlike_its_package`](../../tests/diagnostics/E0603_named_unlike_its_package):

`deps/json/src/main.lt`:

```stilt fragment
pub fn parse(s: str) -> i64 { 1 }
```

`deps/json/stilt.toml`:

```text
[package]
name = "json"
```

`src/main.lt`:

```stilt fragment
fn main() / io { print("app") }
```

`stilt.toml`:

```text
[package]
name = "app"

[dependencies]
jsn = { path = "deps/json" }
```

What `stilt check` prints for it:

```text
── DEPENDENCY NAMED UNLIKE ITS PACKAGE ───────────────── stilt.toml:5:1  [E0603]

This entry names `jsn`, but deps/json/stilt.toml names its package `json`:

  5 │ jsn = { path = "deps/json" }
    │ ^^^

A dependency's entry has its package's own name, so that its modules have one
name everywhere. Rename the entry.

To fix it, name the entry `json`:

  5 │ json = { path = "deps/json" }
    │ ~~~~
```
